headline: Marcos Confirms 2028 Endorsement Plan; Brief Also Cites Press-Freedom Pledge at FOCAP
seoTitle: Marcos Confirms 2028 Endorsement Plan at FOCAP
seoDescription: President Marcos confirmed he intends to endorse a 2028 successor; an FMB News brief also attributes a press-freedom pledge and governance criteria to the same FOCAP appearance.
deck: At a foreign-correspondents event, President Marcos confirmed he plans to endorse a 2028 presidential candidate, while additional remarks in the newsroom brief remain source-attributed.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: Reuters independently reported that President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. confirmed on August 14 that he intends to endorse a candidate in the 2028 presidential election but had not yet chosen whom to support.

The FMB News August 15 morning brief additionally attributes a press-freedom pledge and criteria involving governance continuity and flood-control accountability to the FOCAP appearance. Those additional details are published as newsroom-brief claims because the exact PCO/PIA transcript was not independently reproduced in the final pass.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: The 2028 endorsement plan is independently supported. The additional press-freedom and detailed successor-criteria claims remain source-attributed.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: Succession signals from a sitting president can shape coalition politics, while press-freedom commitments matter directly to journalists and public accountability.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Watch for the official FOCAP or PCO transcript and later administration statements clarifying endorsement criteria.
